_comment: Fresh one-line mnemonics written for this project (NOT copied from shavian.school). Keyed by glyph. Shape claims are limited to ones the source lessons state outright; pairing claims follow Shavian's design rule (tall = unvoiced, deep = voiced partner).
𐑕: Looks like a Latin S — the /s/ in *see*.
𐑦: A dotless Latin i — the short /ɪ/ in *in*.
𐑰: A stretched 𐑦 snapped at the waist — the long /iː/ in *eve*.
𐑞: Voiced 'th' as in *thou*; the deep partner of 𐑔.
𐑟: 𐑕 reversed and dropped low — voiced /z/, the deep partner of 𐑕.
𐑐: A tall hook — unvoiced /p/ as in *pin*.
𐑚: 𐑐 turned upside-down — voiced /b/, dropping deep.
𐑧: The bottom curve of a Latin e — the short /ɛ/ in *edge*.
𐑛: Deep partner of 𐑑 — voiced /d/ as in *done*.
𐑝: Deep partner of 𐑓 — voiced /v/ as in *vie*.
𐑜: A deep version of 𐑒 — voiced /g/ as in *gill*.
𐑔: Tall — unvoiced 'th' as in *thorn*; partner of 𐑞.
𐑗: 𐑑 and 𐑖 fused — the 'ch' in *cha*.
𐑠: Deep partner of 𐑖 — voiced 'zh' as in *measure*.
𐑺: 𐑧 joined to 𐑮 — the 'air' sound; only before r.
𐑸: 𐑭 joined to 𐑮 — the 'ar' sound in *aria*.
𐑡: Deep partner of 𐑗 — voiced /dʒ/ as in *joy*.
